boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Central Florida
boards.description: Late-hour, under-21-safe food and campus stops with publicly posted availability. Check the linked location page before leaving, as hours can change.

cards.title: UCF Student Union
cards.subtitle: Main Campus · building access until 1 a.m. weekdays
cards.notes: Use the atrium or a scheduled program as a late campus stop; confirm vendor and room access separately before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building with posted late weekday access.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF lists Student Union building access Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Student Union | UCF Student Success and Well-Being
cards.access_notes: Building access is posted until 1 a.m. Monday–Friday; individual services and dining vendors may close earlier.

cards.title: Late Knights
cards.subtitle: UCF campus · Friday and Saturday programming
cards.notes: Check the current event listing, bring a valid UCF ID, and choose a scheduled activity that fits your evening.
cards.short_summary: University-run nighttime programming rather than a commercial venue.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Late Knights events generally occur Friday and Saturday nights between 7 p.m. and 1 a.m. and are open to students with valid UCF ID.
cards.source_title: Late Knights | Office of Student Involvement | UCF
cards.access_notes: Events generally run 7 p.m.–1 a.m.; dates, locations, and entry details vary by event.

cards.title: Luminary Green Park
cards.subtitle: UCF Downtown · programmed evening events
cards.notes: Use the event calendar to verify a program at the park, then plan transit and return travel before the event ends.
cards.short_summary: A named UCF Downtown event location with evening programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF's Late Knights page lists a Red, White & Blue Nights event at Luminary Green Park.
cards.source_title: Late Knights | Office of Student Involvement | UCF
cards.access_notes: Use the UCF event listing for date-specific evening access; this is not a statement of daily park hours.

cards.title: UnionWest 6th Floor
cards.subtitle: UCF Downtown · late-night breakfast event venue
cards.notes: Watch UCF Downtown programming for comparable late events and confirm the specific floor access before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named UnionWest venue used for a late-night UCF event.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF listed Bingo & Breakfast: Late Night at UnionWest 6th Floor from 10 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. on April 21, 2026.
cards.source_title: Bingo & Breakfast: Late Night | UCF Events
cards.access_notes: The cited late hours applied to the listed event; verify current programming and building access before visiting.

cards.title: UCF Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: UCF campus · event-listed Late Knights location
cards.notes: Look for a current program at the gallery and use its event details for doors-open, program, and departure timing.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery appearing in Late Knights programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF's Late Knights page lists Pathways 2026: The Carlos Malamud Prize at the UCF Art Gallery.
cards.source_title: Late Knights | Office of Student Involvement | UCF
cards.access_notes: Late Knights generally schedules programming between 7 p.m. and 1 a.m.; verify this gallery event's current hours.

cards.title: IHOP on University Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 11571 University Blvd. · Orlando
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm service and ordering options, then choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery as needed.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard restaurant with 24-hour posted service.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists this 11571 University Blvd. restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies it as offering late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official location page posts 24-hour service daily; check directly before travel for exceptions.

cards.title: McDonald's on University Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 3162 University Blvd. · Winter Park
cards.notes: Confirm the restaurant and drive-thru are operating before leaving; the official page separates those posted service hours.
cards.short_summary: A nearby University Boulevard option posting round-the-clock restaurant and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists its 3162 University Blvd. Winter Park restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 3162 University Blvd., Winter Park
cards.access_notes: Official page posts 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru service daily; confirm live status before travel.

cards.title: Del Taco on East Colonial
cards.subtitle: 3105 E Colonial Dr. · Orlando
cards.notes: Check the official page for the day’s closing time and order method before setting out from the UCF area.
cards.short_summary: An East Colonial food stop with posted service into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco posts hours until 2 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday for this Orlando location.
cards.source_title: Del Taco at 3105 E Colonial Dr., Orlando
cards.access_notes: Officially posted closing times range from 2–3 a.m. by day; verify the live location page before travel.

cards.title: Del Taco on Grand National Drive
cards.subtitle: 6855 Grand National Dr. · Orlando
cards.notes: Use the location page for same-day hours and pickup details; weekend service is posted later than most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: An Orlando location with official service posted as late as 4 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco posts hours until 2 a.m. most days and until 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday for this Orlando location.
cards.source_title: Del Taco at 6855 Grand National Drive, Orlando
cards.access_notes: Officially posted closing times range from 2–4 a.m. by day; confirm the live page before traveling.

cards.title: Student Union Atrium
cards.subtitle: Main Campus · finals-week late-night breakfast venue
cards.notes: Check UCF finals communications for the next scheduled breakfast and arrive during the stated event window with campus access in mind.
cards.short_summary: A named atrium venue used for a late-night student breakfast during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF announced a free Late Knight Breakfast in the Student Union Atrium from 10 p.m. to midnight on April 28, 2026.
cards.source_title: Conquering Spring 2026 Finals Week with the Right Resources | UCF Today
cards.access_notes: The cited 10 p.m.–midnight hours applied to the April 28, 2026 event; verify future finals programming.

warnings: Several campus entries are event-based rather than daily late-night destinations; use their direct UCF pages to confirm a current date and access details before travel.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UCF spaces for focused work, collaborative projects, campus connection, and active breaks.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, main floor
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and choose a seat that matches your task; the commons combines desktop stations, power access, soft seating, and group-study settings.
cards.short_summary: A large library learning and technology environment with varied seating and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries describes the Knowledge Commons as a 24,800-square-foot learning and technology environment with seating, desktop PCs, power access, soft seating, group settings, and portable whiteboards.
cards.source_title: John C. Hitt Library | UCF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in the John C. Hitt Library; use it in accordance with library policies.

cards.title: Reading Room – Room 405
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Set up here when you want a quiet academic work session with room to spread out; keep conversations appropriately subdued for the library setting.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet-study room with extensive seating and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries identifies Room 405 as a quiet study space with 235 seats and a 270-degree view of the UCF campus.
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of the John C. Hitt Library; follow posted quiet-study expectations.

cards.title: Silent Study – Room 450
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Use this room for reading, writing, or assignment work that needs minimal interruption; silence your phone and plan to work without conversation.
cards.short_summary: A designated no-talking study room with 131 seats.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries states that Silent Study, Room 450, is a fourth-floor space for uninterrupted individual work with 131 seats; talking is prohibited.
cards.access_notes: Fourth floor of the John C. Hitt Library; cell phones must be silenced and talking is prohibited.

cards.title: Digital Exploration Center
cards.subtitle: Room 425, John C. Hitt Library
cards.notes: Visit when a class project needs digital experimentation or creative production; check with DEC staff about available tools, consultation, and programming.
cards.short_summary: A library hub for collaborative digital projects and immersive technology exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries describes the Digital Exploration Center as an interdisciplinary hub where students and faculty develop collaborative digital projects, explore immersive technologies, and pursue creative production.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 425 of the John C. Hitt Library; staff support and programming are available.

cards.entity_name: John C. Hitt Library Study Rooms
cards.title: John C. Hitt Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: First, third, and fourth floors
cards.notes: Reserve a room before meeting your project group, then check in promptly; use the space for course-related work and respect its capacity limits.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for group study and course-related work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries states that its study rooms support group study, are available to enrolled students, and can be reserved up to three days ahead for up to four hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Available to current UCF students, faculty, and staff; reservation and check-in rules apply.

cards.title: UCF Student Union
cards.subtitle: Central Orlando campus
cards.notes: Use the building as a central meetup point for studying, eating, attending events, or connecting between classes; consult the current schedule before planning.
cards.short_summary: UCF’s central student-life building for study, dining, events, meetings, and social time.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Student Union states that it provides space for the UCF community to study, socialize, eat, host events, attend meetings, celebrate traditions, and engage in campus life.
cards.access_notes: Operating hours and special hours vary with the academic calendar; check the Student Union page before visiting.

cards.title: Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: UCF Main Campus
cards.notes: Plan an active break or a workout around the facility’s available areas; review recreation policies and current access details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: UCF’s main student recreation facility with fitness, courts, a track, climbing wall, and pools.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center as its main student recreation facility, with fitness areas, courts, an indoor track, group-fitness rooms, a climbing wall, and an outdoor leisure pool.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | University of Central Florida
cards.access_notes: UCF Main Campus facility; check Recreation and Wellness Center policies and current hours before visiting.

cards.title: RWC Climbing Tower
cards.subtitle: Inside the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.notes: Try an indoor climbing session at a route suited to your experience level, and follow staff direction plus all required climbing procedures and equipment rules.
cards.short_summary: A 41-foot indoor climbing tower with more than 20 top-rope routes.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center describes its Climbing Tower as a 41-foot indoor tower with more than 20 top-rope routes across a range of difficulties.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Located within the Recreation and Wellness Center; follow staff instructions and current facility procedures.

cards.title: MAC Gym
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center multipurpose courts
cards.notes: Check whether a court is reserved, then use an open court for a casual activity; obtain any available equipment through the member services desk.
cards.short_summary: Two enclosed multipurpose courts within the Recreation and Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center states that the MAC Gym has two courts and that, when not reserved, the courts are first-come, first-served; equipment is available for checkout.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Court availability depends on reservations; check in with the member services desk for current use and equipment procedures.

cards.title: RWC Park Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: RWC Park, UCF Main Campus
cards.notes: Use daylight for a nine-hole round and bring or arrange appropriate disc equipment; share the outdoor space carefully with other campus users.
cards.short_summary: A nine-hole outdoor disc golf course at RWC Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Recreation and Wellness Center states that the RWC Park Disc Golf Course is a nine-hole course available to the UCF community and open during daylight hours every day.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Recreation and Wellness Center | UCF
cards.access_notes: Located in RWC Park; the facility page lists the course as open during daylight hours each day.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, under-21-safe UCF activities with no admission charge or no additional cost for eligible current students.

cards.title: Take a self-guided Arboretum tour
cards.subtitle: UCF Arboretum natural areas
cards.notes: Start with the Arboretum’s self-guided-tour information, then set an easy pace through the natural areas. Stay on permitted paths and leave plants where they grow.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor walk through UCF’s campus natural areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF offers self-guided Arboretum tours, and its natural areas and trails are open to the public daily with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset every day; no admission charge. Donations are appreciated.

cards.title: Walk the Arboretum trails
cards.subtitle: UCF Arboretum natural areas
cards.notes: Meet for a daylight trail walk and choose a turnaround point before you begin. Bring water, follow posted rules, and skip collecting any plant material.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission nature hang on campus trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Arboretum’s natural areas and trails are open to the public from sunrise to sunset every day of the year, with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset daily; no admission charge. Camping, fires, and barbecues are prohibited.

cards.title: See the UCF Art Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: Visual Arts Building, Room 140
cards.notes: Drop into the Visual Arts Building during gallery hours and spend time with the current exhibition. Check the gallery page before going because exhibitions change.
cards.short_summary: Free visual-art viewing on the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Art Gallery is in the Visual Arts Building on UCF’s main campus and admission is free.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery | UCF Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 10 a.m.-5 p.m.; closed on major holidays. Gallery admission is free.

cards.title: Attend a gallery reception
cards.subtitle: UCF Art Gallery, Visual Arts Building
cards.notes: Watch the gallery calendar for a reception, then arrive during the listed window to view the work and talk about it with your group. Confirm dates before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-facing art reception when one is scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that Art Gallery receptions are typically held 5-7 p.m. and are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Ticketing Information - UCF College of Arts and Humanities
cards.access_notes: Receptions are typically 5-7 p.m.; verify the current exhibition calendar before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Fitness Workout
cards.title: Work out at the RWC
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Bring your UCF ID and make a simple workout date at the Recreation and Wellness Center. Pick equipment appropriate to your experience and follow facility guidance.
cards.short_summary: A student-access fitness session with no additional membership charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Students who have paid the Activity and Service Fee have unlimited membership to all RWC facilities at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students; valid picture ID is required for entry.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Leisure Pool Swim
cards.title: Meet at the RWC Leisure Pool
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Coordinate a swim session at the Leisure Pool and check RWC facility guidance before leaving. Use the pool only when it is open and follow lifeguard instructions.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-cost pool hang for eligible UCF students.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists its Leisure Pool among its facilities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; confirm pool availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Lap Pool Swim
cards.title: Swim laps at the RWC
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a low-key lap-swim session, choosing a lane that matches your pace. Check the RWC schedule and comply with posted aquatics rules.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus lap pool without an additional facility charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists a nine-lane regulation lap pool among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; check aquatics availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Indoor Track Walk
cards.title: Walk the RWC indoor track
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Set a conversation-friendly walking pace on the indoor track and agree on a lap count or time goal. Bring your UCF ID and observe posted facility etiquette.
cards.short_summary: A weather-proof walk using student RWC access.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists a one-eighth-mile track among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; valid picture ID is required for entry.

cards.entity_name: Recreation and Wellness Center Basketball Court Game
cards.title: Play a pickup basketball game
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness Center main facility
cards.notes: Gather a small group for a casual game on the RWC courts, sharing the space respectfully with other users. Check the facility schedule and bring student ID.
cards.short_summary: Indoor court time through eligible student RWC access.
cards.evidence_claim: The RWC lists multipurpose courts among its amenities, and eligible fee-paying UCF students have unlimited RWC membership at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current fee-paying UCF students with RWC access; court availability may vary by programming.

cards.title: Paddle Lake Claire
cards.subtitle: William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.notes: Use an active student ID to check out a kayak, canoe, or paddleboard at Lake Claire. Follow boathouse instructions; swimming, fishing, and personal watercraft are prohibited.
cards.short_summary: Free student equipment rental at UCF’s Lake Claire recreation area.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says current students with active student ID can rent Lake Claire equipment, including kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards, for free.
cards.source_title: The William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.access_notes: Anyone may go to Lake Claire, but equipment rental is for current UCF students with active student ID; no guest passes currently.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named, campus-based UCF study environments with documented quiet, collaborative, computer, or reservable-work features.

cards.title: Set up beneath the vaulted ceiling
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy task and choose a seat facing the campus view; the room has 235 seats and natural light.
cards.short_summary: A large, quiet reading room with high ceilings and broad campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries describes Room 405 as a quiet fourth-floor study space with 235 seats, vaulted ceilings, and a 270-degree campus view.
cards.access_notes: Located in the John C. Hitt Library; check library access and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Use the no-talk zone for deep focus
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Silence your phone before settling in and save collaborative work for another room; this 131-seat space prohibits talking.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent room for uninterrupted individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries states that Silent Study, Room 450, has 131 seats and requires silenced phones with no talking.
cards.access_notes: Located in the John C. Hitt Library; follow the no-talking rule and check library access and hours.

cards.title: Build a work session around a desktop
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, second floor main level
cards.notes: Choose this open commons when you need a desktop, accessible power, portable whiteboard, or flexible group seating.
cards.short_summary: A large technology-rich commons for individual or collaborative coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries lists the Knowledge Commons as a 24,800-square-foot learning and technology environment with 196 desktop PCs, power-accessible seating, varied seating, and portable whiteboards.
cards.source_title: John C. Hitt Library - UCF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's second-floor main level; check library access and hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: John C. Hitt Library First-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a ground-floor project room
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, first floor
cards.notes: Book ahead for course-related group work, then check in within 15 minutes using the confirmation link or room QR code.
cards.short_summary: Reservable first-floor rooms for structured group study.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries lists study rooms on the John C. Hitt Library first floor and says eligible UCF users may reserve rooms up to four hours per day.
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled UCF students, faculty, and staff; reserve up to three days ahead and check in within 15 minutes.

cards.entity_name: John C. Hitt Library Third-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Plan a small group session upstairs
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use a reservable room for course work, and leave promptly if another patron has a reservation for the unlocked space.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor reservable rooms suited to focused group coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries lists multiple third-floor John C. Hitt Library study rooms and states that unreserved users may be asked to leave when a reservation begins.
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled UCF students, faculty, and staff; rooms are unlocked but require a reservation when claimed.

cards.entity_name: John C. Hitt Library Fourth-Floor Study Rooms
cards.title: Book a fourth-floor room near quiet study
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Reserve before you arrive for group coursework; selected rooms include motion-activated door openers for easier access.
cards.short_summary: Reservable fourth-floor study rooms alongside the library's quiet-study level.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries lists fourth-floor study rooms and identifies rooms 459, 461, and 469 as having motion-activated door openers.
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled UCF students, faculty, and staff; use the library reservation system and observe room occupancy limits.

cards.title: Gather a larger team in Suite 360
cards.subtitle: John C. Hitt Library, third floor
cards.notes: Choose this option for a larger group and reserve through LibCal; each conference room seats up to 12 people.
cards.short_summary: Two bookable third-floor conference rooms for larger study teams.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Libraries says two Suite 360 Conference Rooms on the third floor seat up to 12 people and are bookable through LibCal.
cards.access_notes: Available for booking via LibCal; confirm availability and applicable library booking rules before going.

cards.entity_name: Technology Commons I Group Study Spaces
cards.title: Pair group work with a computer lab
cards.subtitle: Technology Commons I, main campus
cards.notes: Head here when your group needs campus computers or device support; the commons also provides laptop and tablet checkout.
cards.short_summary: Group-study space within UCF's technology commons network.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Academic Advocacy states that Technology Commons offers large computer labs, laptop and tablet checkout, and group study spaces in Technology Commons I.
cards.access_notes: Check Technology Commons operations and equipment-loan requirements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Technology Commons II Group Study Spaces
cards.title: Work beside campus tech support
cards.subtitle: Technology Commons II, main campus
cards.notes: Use this campus computer-lab setting for a group work block, and contact the Student Support Desk if a device problem comes up.
cards.short_summary: A group-work option connected to UCF computer labs and support.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Academic Advocacy identifies Technology Commons II as one of the locations with large computer labs, group study spaces, and access to the Student Support Desk.
cards.access_notes: Check Technology Commons operations and equipment-loan requirements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Classroom Building I, Room 101 Group Study Space
cards.title: Make Room 101 your tech-enabled meeting point
cards.subtitle: Classroom Building I, Room 101, main campus
cards.notes: Use this named group-study location when you need a computer-lab environment; ask the Student Support Desk for device assistance.
cards.short_summary: A specifically identified group-study location within Classroom Building I.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Academic Advocacy lists Classroom Building I, Room 101 among Technology Commons locations offering large computer labs and group study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Check Technology Commons operations and room availability before visiting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors immediately around UCF’s main campus, each with one source-backed reason to stop or orient yourself there.

cards.title: UCF Health East Orlando
cards.subtitle: Quadrangle Boulevard corridor, facing University Boulevard
cards.notes: Use this UCF Health site as an orientation point for the Quadrangle Boulevard corridor; its official page places it blocks from main campus facing University Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A university health facility positioned on the University Boulevard-facing edge of Quadrangle Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Health states that its East Orlando facility is on Quadrangle Boulevard, just blocks from UCF’s main campus, facing University Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Tour Our Facilities | Orlando | UCF Health
cards.access_notes: Clinical access and appointment requirements are not stated on this location page; confirm directly with UCF Health before visiting.

cards.title: Chipotle U of Central Florida
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor near Arden Villas Boulevard
cards.notes: Follow University Boulevard to the restaurant’s listed address near Arden Villas Boulevard when you want a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, salad, or quesadilla meal.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard restaurant with a menu built around customizable fast-casual entrées.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its U of Central Florida restaurant at 11680 University Blvd, near University Blvd and Arden Villas Blvd, and describes burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill in Orlando, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours and ordering options are listed on the location page; check it before making a special trip.

cards.title: The Celeste Hotel
cards.subtitle: North Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Alafaya Trail address as a landmark when arranging a visitor meeting point or exploring the corridor beyond the campus’s eastern edge.
cards.short_summary: A named UCF-area hotel destination on North Alafaya Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Athletics lists The Celeste at 4105 N Alafaya Trail in Orlando.
cards.source_title: Visiting UCF: Champions Play at UCF
cards.access_notes: Hotel and restaurant services may have separate availability; contact the property for current visitor arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.title: Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.subtitle: North Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use the organization’s own directions page to locate this named community destination at 3144 North Alafaya Trail and confirm an event before attending.
cards.short_summary: A Jewish campus-community destination with a published North Alafaya Trail address.
cards.evidence_claim: Chabad at UCF’s directions page lists its address as 3144 N Alafaya Trail, Orlando, FL 32826.
cards.source_title: Directions - Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.access_notes: Programming and visitor arrangements are not specified on the directions page; contact Chabad at UCF before attending.

cards.title: Boardwalk at Alafaya Trail
cards.subtitle: Alafaya Trail corridor via Boardwalk Drive
cards.notes: Use this named residential destination to understand the Alafaya Trail edge of campus; the property identifies itself as less than one mile from UCF.
cards.short_summary: A named off-campus residential destination immediately off the Alafaya Trail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Boardwalk at Alafaya Trail states that it is located less than one mile from UCF in Orlando, right off Alafaya Trail.
cards.access_notes: This is a residential property; arrange leasing or visitor access directly with its management.

cards.title: The Pointe at Central
cards.subtitle: Alafaya Trail corridor near University Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the property’s neighborhood page to place this named destination between Alafaya Trail and University Boulevard while mapping the campus-adjacent commercial area.
cards.short_summary: A named residential destination near the Alafaya Trail and University Boulevard connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pointe at Central says it is near Alafaya Trail and a short distance from University Blvd and Alafaya Village & Commons.
cards.access_notes: This is a residential property; arrange leasing or visitor access directly with its management.

cards.title: Partnership III
cards.subtitle: Technology Parkway corridor in Central Florida Research Park
cards.notes: Navigate to Partnership III for the UCF Institute for Simulation and Training’s Synthetic Reality Lab; UCF provides its address and transport guidance from main campus.
cards.short_summary: A UCF research destination in the Technology Parkway section of Central Florida Research Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s Synthetic Reality Lab says it is inside Partnership III at 3039 Technology Pkwy and describes it as south of UCF Main Campus.
cards.access_notes: This is an academic research facility; confirm public access or any scheduled activity with the lab before visiting.

cards.title: UCF Communication Disorders Clinic
cards.subtitle: Progress Drive corridor in Central Florida Research Park
cards.notes: Use the clinic’s published Progress Drive address when navigating the research-park corridor; schedule or contact the clinic before seeking clinical services.
cards.short_summary: A UCF clinical destination at the Progress Drive entrance to Central Florida Research Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that its Communication Disorders Clinic is in the Innovative Center at 3280 Progress Drive in Central Florida Research Park.
cards.source_title: UCF Communication Disorders Clinic information packet
cards.access_notes: Clinical services require advance coordination; use the clinic’s contact information to confirm current appointment procedures.

cards.title: Blanchard Park
cards.subtitle: North Dean Road corridor
cards.notes: Head to the North Dean Road entrance for an Orange County park with trails, picnic areas, courts, a playground, and the Little Econ Greenway running through it.
cards.short_summary: An 84-acre county park where the Little Econ Greenway and river pass through the site.
cards.evidence_claim: Orange County lists Blanchard Park at 2451 N Dean Rd and identifies trails, courts, picnic areas, a playground, and the 7.4-mile Little Econ Greenway Trail.
cards.access_notes: Orange County lists summer hours of 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and winter hours of 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; rental pavilions require separate arrangements.

cards.title: Alafaya Commons
cards.subtitle: East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use this named retail center to orient yourself at the East Colonial Drive–Alafaya Trail junction; its property page identifies a direct Alafaya Trail connection to UCF.
cards.short_summary: A named commercial destination at the East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Alafaya Commons is listed at 11841–11931 E Colonial Drive, at the intersection of East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail, with a direct connection to UCF via Alafaya Trail.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own access rules and hours; verify the destination you intend to visit before traveling.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring UCF traditions documented on the university’s official traditions page, spanning welcome week, Homecoming, arts, service and campus gatherings.

cards.title: Start at Pegasus Palooza
cards.subtitle: UCF’s official fall Welcome Week
cards.notes: Check the current Pegasus Palooza schedule, then use its social, academic and service activities to get oriented during fall welcome week.
cards.short_summary: UCF’s official fall welcome-week tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies Pegasus Palooza as its official Welcome Week, held each fall with social, academic and service activities.
cards.access_notes: See the official event schedule for current dates, locations and participation details.

cards.title: Be Welcomed at The Knighting
cards.subtitle: New-Knight formal convocation
cards.notes: Attend if you are a new student and want the formal welcome that marks induction into UCF’s student community.
cards.short_summary: A formal convocation welcoming new UCF students.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes The Knighting as a formal convocation marking a student’s induction as an official UCF student.
cards.access_notes: Intended for new students; confirm current orientation programming and eligibility before attending.

cards.title: Charge into Spirit Splash
cards.subtitle: Homecoming at the Reflecting Pond
cards.notes: If participating, wear items that can get wet and follow event staff directions while joining the Homecoming pep rally at the pond.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming pond rush for collectible ducks and shirts.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Spirit Splash is a Homecoming Week pep rally where Knights enter the Reflecting Pond for collectible rubber ducks and commemorative T-shirts.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Homecoming instructions and on-site safety guidance; conditions and access may change.

cards.title: Share Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: An annual UCF family tradition
cards.notes: Invite family to experience campus together, and confirm the current weekend’s registration, events and visitor guidance before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A campus tradition centered on students showing family around UCF.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF presents Family Weekend as a tradition for students to spend time with family and show them around campus.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Family Weekend program for dates, registration requirements and individual event details.

cards.title: Keep Moving at Knight-Thon
cards.subtitle: Spring dance marathon for a local children’s hospital
cards.notes: Register through the current Knight-Thon organizers, wear comfortable shoes and participate in the spring dance marathon’s fundraising activities.
cards.short_summary: A spring dance-marathon tradition supporting a local children’s hospital.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies Knight-Thon as a spring dance marathon that raises funds for a local children’s hospital.
cards.access_notes: Check Knight-Thon’s current registration, fundraising and event information before participating.

cards.title: Make Time for UCF Celebrates the Arts
cards.subtitle: Spring 10-day university arts festival
cards.notes: Browse the current festival program and choose a musical, living-art or concert performance that fits your schedule and access needs.
cards.short_summary: A 10-day festival showcasing UCF creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes UCF Celebrates the Arts as a 10-day festival featuring musicals, living art and concert performances.
cards.access_notes: Individual performances may have separate reservations or admission policies; consult the current festival program.

cards.title: Bring a Blanket to Symphony Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: Annual outdoor concert on Memory Mall
cards.notes: Pack a blanket and picnic, then check the current concert announcement for weather, timing and any site-specific visitor instructions.
cards.short_summary: An annual outdoor UCF Symphony Orchestra concert.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Symphony Under the Stars is an annual outdoor Memory Mall concert performed by the UCF Symphony Orchestra.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and arrangements vary; verify the current announcement before traveling to Memory Mall.

cards.title: Take the Universal Knights Study Break
cards.subtitle: Spring access to Universal’s Islands of Adventure
cards.notes: Watch Student Government announcements for the current process and eligibility, then plan for the spring late-night park event with fellow Knights.
cards.short_summary: A spring UCF outing with exclusive late-night park access.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that Universal Knights gives thousands of Knights exclusive, late-night access to Universal’s Islands of Adventure each spring and is free.
cards.access_notes: UCF lists this as a spring event; confirm current Student Government eligibility, registration and transportation details.

cards.title: Pull Up a Chair at Gather Luncheon
cards.subtitle: Annual community meal on Memory Mall
cards.notes: Look for the annual event notice and reserve or arrive as instructed to join the community meal with other Knights on Memory Mall.
cards.short_summary: An annual community-building meal for hundreds of Knights.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the annual Gather Luncheon brings 500 Knights together for a free, three-course meal focused on community building.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location and any RSVP requirements through the official event announcement.

cards.title: See Student Research Week in Action
cards.subtitle: Spring undergraduate research showcase
cards.notes: Review the current Research Week calendar and choose a workshop or showcase event to see undergraduate research presented on campus.
cards.short_summary: A spring week of workshops and undergraduate research events.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the Showcase of Undergraduate Research Excellence is part of Student Research Week, which hosts workshops and events in early April.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Research Week calendar for event format, venue and any required registration.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Central Florida, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus loop that moves from orientation landmarks to outdoor space, recreation, art, and a practical study stop.

cards.title: Start at the Reflecting Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus landmark
cards.notes: Begin near Millican Hall, take a lap around the pond, and use the open edge to orient yourself before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A central landmark for starting a self-guided campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s self-guided tour begins in front of Millican Hall at the Reflecting Pond, and UCF describes it as a marquee informal gathering location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; follow posted campus and event-use rules.

cards.title: Use the Student Union as your waypoint
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Heart of Campus
cards.notes: Step inside to locate student resources and dining options, then exit toward the Boardwalk for a scenic route to nearby campus stops.
cards.short_summary: A central hub for resources, activities, student spaces, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the Student Union as the Heart of Campus and a hub for student resources, activities, student spaces, and dining options.
cards.access_notes: Indoor services and dining availability can vary; check the Union before making plans.

cards.title: Walk the John T. Washington Center breezeway
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · beside the Student Union
cards.notes: Follow the breezeway beside the library and Union, pausing to view the John T. Washington mural and identify services you may use later.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering place with services along the breezeway.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the John T. Washington Center is adjacent to the library and Student Union and features a mural honoring Washington’s campus contributions.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor breezeway; individual businesses and services set their own availability.

cards.title: Pause on Memory Mall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · between the Union and Addition Financial Arena
cards.notes: Cross the large lawn at an easy pace and note the paths toward Knights Plaza and the arena, saving event plans for another day.
cards.short_summary: An expansive campus lawn between the Student Union and Addition Financial Arena.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes Memory Mall as the large grass area between the Student Union and Addition Financial Arena.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; scheduled events and reservations may affect use.

cards.title: See what is on view at UCF Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Visual Arts Building
cards.notes: Visit the gallery during weekday public hours, take in the current exhibition, and use the Visual Arts Building as a new campus reference point.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus gallery visit with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCF Art Gallery is in the Visual Arts Building on main campus, is open Monday–Friday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and has free admission.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery — UCF Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on major holidays. Complimentary parking is available in Garage F.

cards.title: Take a daylight Arboretum walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 4312 Scorpius St.
cards.notes: Choose a self-guided path through the natural areas or campus landscapes, bring water, and finish before sunset rather than rushing the loop.
cards.short_summary: A public, no-admission nature stop for a self-guided walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Arboretum natural areas and trails are open to the public from sunrise to sunset every day, with no admission charge.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to sunset daily; trails are not currently wheelchair accessible, though an all-terrain wheelchair is available on request.

cards.entity_name: William E. and Mary Jo Davis Recreation Area at Lake Claire
cards.title: Get outside at Lake Claire
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Lake Claire Recreation Area
cards.notes: Visit the recreation area with friends, check the Outdoor Adventure desk for current equipment options, and follow all posted water-safety policies.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation area with outdoor facilities and water-vessel checkouts.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Lake Claire offers students equipment and water-vessel checkouts through its Outdoor Adventure program.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Adventure — UCF Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.access_notes: Swimming, alcohol, tobacco, fishing, and motorized boats are prohibited; equipment rentals require a waiver and may have fees.

cards.title: Tour the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · recreation and fitness stop
cards.notes: Stop by to learn the layout, then plan a future workout or climbing session after confirming your student eligibility and current facility access.
cards.short_summary: A large recreation facility with fitness, aquatics, courts, and climbing.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s campus tour identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center as a 150,000-square-foot facility with pools, fitness areas, a climbing tower, and courts.
cards.access_notes: Facility use is subject to current Recreation and Wellness Center eligibility, policies, and operating hours.

cards.title: Plan a future Challenge Course session
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · near the Barbara Ying Center
cards.notes: If you have a group to bring together, review the low-element options and reservation process instead of arriving expecting a walk-in activity.
cards.short_summary: A reservation-based adventure-learning program for team building.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that its Challenge Course supports team building, self-confidence, and leadership through adventure-based learning and is open by reservation or special event only.
cards.source_title: Challenge Course — UCF Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.access_notes: Reservation or special event required; program prices vary. Wear required athletic attire and closed-toe shoes when participating.

cards.title: End with a library reset
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · next to the Reflecting Pond
cards.notes: Pick a study setting, locate the research-help desk, and make a short list of services you can return to when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: A central study and research hub with varied workspaces and support.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies the John C. Hitt Library as its main library, with open study areas, group rooms, computer labs, research help, and tutoring and writing support.
cards.source_title: John C. Hitt Library — UCF Location
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and access rules before visiting; visitor parking may require a permit or meter payment.
